QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_39

question.text: RVPI (Residual Value to Paid-in Capital) represents:

explanation.text: The Logic: RVPI = Unrealized value (AUM) / Total Paid-in Capital. The Trap: First option is DPI; NAV/realized gains or IRR are different metrics. Cross-Exam Context: Triangulated with DPI and TVPI. Distributor's Pro-Tip: High RVPI in early years is normal — the portfolio hasn't been harvested yet.
